title: The State’s own warning checklist on each school budget
question: On the State criteria-and-standards summary each budget carries, which standards were not met and which warning questions were answered yes?
finding: 2024-25 adopted budget (June 2024): 15 items flagged (1 Average Daily Attendance, 3 ADA to Enrollment, 4 Local Control Funding Formula (LCFF), 6b Other Expenditures, 7 Ongoing and Major Maintenance Account, S5 Contributions); 2025-26 adopted budget (June 2025): 10 items flagged (3 ADA to Enrollment, 4 Local Control Funding Formula (LCFF), 5 Salaries and Benefits, 6b Other Expenditures, S5 Contributions, S7b Other Self-insurance Benefits); 2026-27 recommended budget (June 2026): 11 items flagged (5 Salaries and Benefits, 6b Other Expenditures, S4 Contingent Revenues, S5 Contributions, S6 Long-term Commitments, S7b Other Self-insurance Benefits); 2026-27 County Office of Education recommended budget (June 2026): 10 items flagged (1b ADA - County Programs, 2 Local Control Funding Formula (LCFF), 3 Salaries and Benefits, 4b Other Expenditures, 5 Ongoing and Major Maintenance, S7b Other Self-insurance Benefits).
how: The Criteria and Standards Review Summary page of each budget: an X in the "Not Met" column (standards 1 to 10) or the "Yes" column (supplemental items S1 to S10 and fiscal indicators A1 to A9) counts as flagged. The column is read from the X’s position on the text layer.
limits: The State says these "may indicate areas of potential concern"; many are routine (a district with labour talks open answers yes to S8). The summary is filled in automatically from the district’s own entries.
